342    /**
343     * Get city and region together
344     * We need it because city and region must comply each other in Ukraine
345     *
346     * @example 'Закарпатська область, місто Ужгород'
347     *
348     * @return string
349     */
350    public function cityAndRegion()
351    {
352        $regionAndCityNumber = self::numberBetween(0, count(static::$region) - 1);
353        $region = static::$region[$regionAndCityNumber];
354        $city = static::$city[$regionAndCityNumber];
355        $format = "$region {{regionSuffix}}, {{cityPrefix}} $city";
356
357        return $this->generator->parse($format);
358    }
359
